items.name: layered-panel
items.title: Layered Panel
items.description: Right-hand peek panel that expands in place to a two-column detail view. No route change. Optional Next.js URL sync keeps Back working: full collapses to peek, then closes. Ships no theme, cssVars, or global CSS — it uses the host project's shadcn tokens and primitives.
items.author: Eduardo Retana

meta.descriptionEs: Panel de detalle que se abre a la derecha y crece en el mismo lugar hasta dos columnas. La ruta no cambia, así que la tabla conserva el scroll.

api.name: onOpenChange
api.description: Called when the dialog asks to open or close.

api.name: onModeChange
api.description: Called when the panel switches between peek and full.

api.name: peekWidth
api.description: Desktop peek width. Any single CSS length. Default 26.25rem.

api.name: closeLabel
api.description: Accessible name of the close button. Default Close.

api.name: mobilePeekLabel / mobileFullLabel
api.description: Tab labels below 1024px. Defaults Overview and Profile.

api.name: className and slot classes
api.description: overlayClassName, closeClassName, tabsClassName, tabClassName, gridClassName, plus className on every compound part.

api.name: LayeredPanel.Peek / Full
api.description: Peek stays on the right. Full is the left column and stays hidden until mode is full.

api.name: LayeredPanel.ExpandToggle
api.description: expandLabel and collapseLabel. Defaults View full profile and Close profile.

api.name: DetailSection / DetailField
api.description: Uppercase section label and a field row with optional icon, value, and href.

api.name: useLayeredPanelUrlState
api.description: Optional Next.js hook. ?member=id opens peek. &view=full expands. Back collapses, then closes.

items.docs: Import LayeredPanel from the installed UI file. URL sync is a separate hook (use-layered-panel-url-state) and is the only file that imports next/navigation. Below 1024px the panel is a full-screen sheet with tabs. The item declares button, scroll-area, and separator as registryDependencies and does not vendor copies. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite those files. No cssVars.
